name: classdb_query
description: Query Godot's ClassDB for class information: properties, methods, signals, and inheritance. Use this to verify that a class, method, or property actually exists in the running Godot engine before writing code. Prevents using wrong method names, outdated Godot 3 API, or incorrect signatures.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring: only members whose name contains it are returned. Use when checking for a specific method/property (e.g. "velocity") on a big class — cuts the output massively.

include_virtual.description: Include well-known virtual methods like _ready, _process, _input (default: true). Set to false to see only public non-virtual methods.
